title: Bound boot-recovery retries for unrecorded finished delegation children whose bind keeps failing
outcome: Round-10 review of tm-8b7y (Claude delegation-040ec103): a failed or canceled delegation child loaded from a store written before begins were recorded (begins_recorded=false) stays a boot-recovery target, sorted after live sessions and bounded per boot by bootRecoveryBudgetMs, until one accepted bind marks it recorded. A child whose bind fails for a lasting reason (for example a persistent protocol refusal) therefore costs a bind attempt and a short-lived sidecar on every boot with no upper limit. Consider, if it shows up in practice, stopping the retry or logging such a child after N failed boots, or marking it recorded once Engram's answer is a definitive refusal that proves no begun grant remains.
